faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Range Rover P460e use?
faqLeft.a: The Range Rover P460e uses the AJ300 turbo PHEV I6 — a 3.0-litre petrol inline-six with a 105kW electric motor. It's the same engine family as the P440e, P510e and P550e, with the badge tracking the power output tier.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Range Rover P460e engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my P460e?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine code before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ300 Range Rover P460e engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn timing chains, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every AJ300 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Range Rover P460e engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Range Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Range Rover P460e engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Range Rover owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
